chapter_en: Chapter 138: Selling oneself into service under a master

units.chapter: 鬻身投主章第一百三十八
units.chapter_en: Chapter 138: Selling oneself into service under a master
units.title: 鬻身投主总纲：以世应为主、父母为凭；命运乖违必致鬻身延岁月、年时饥馑还须投主度晨昏，要决平生之事当寻持世之爻，不破不冲百年可辅、落空落陷一载难从；鬻身者出乎不得已须择良善之主，世爻旺相生扶可以聊生，世落空亡或值日冲月破虽暂时安置终身落寞终是不久

rule.yi: 要卖身投靠主人（鬻身投主），以世爻、应爻为主，以父母爻为凭据。命运不顺，必定要卖身来延续岁月；年成饥荒，还得投靠主人来度过早晚。要决断一生的事，应当寻找持世的爻：不破不冲，一百年都可以得到辅助；落空落陷，一年也难以相从。卖身投主的人是出于不得已，必须选择良善的主人：世爻旺相、得到生扶，可以勉强过活；世爻落空亡，或者遇到日冲、月破，虽然是暂时安顿，毕竟一生落寞，即使勉强维持，终究不久。
rule.en: In selling oneself into service under a master, take the Self and the Other as the chief and Resource as the ground. When one's fate runs against one, one must sell oneself to prolong one's days; in a famine year one must still take a master to get through morning and evening. To decide the affairs of a lifetime, one should seek the line that holds the Self: if it is neither broken nor clashed, a hundred years can be aided; if it falls to Void or into a pit, it is hard to follow even for one year. Those who sell themselves do so out of necessity and must choose a good and kind master: if the Self line is thriving and supported one can eke out a living; if the Self falls on Void, or meets the Day's clash or Month-break, then although one is temporarily settled, in the end one is desolate all one's life, and even if one makes do it will not last.

zh: 以世应为主，父母为凭。
yi: 以世爻、应爻为主要看的，以父母爻为凭据。
en: Take the Self and the Other as the chief to be looked at, and Resource as the ground.

zh: 命运乖违，必致鬻身延岁月。年时饥馑，还须投主度晨昏。
要决平生之事，当寻持世之爻。
不破不冲，百年可辅。
落空落陷，一载难从。
yi: 命运不顺，必定要卖身来延续岁月；年成饥荒，还得投靠主人来度过早晚。
要决断一生的事，应当寻找持世的爻。
（持世之爻）不破不冲，一百年都可以得到辅助；
（持世之爻）落空落陷，一年也难以相从。
en: When one's fate runs against one, one must sell oneself to prolong one's days; in a famine year one must still take a master to get through morning and evening.
To decide the affairs of a lifetime, one should seek the line that holds the Self.
If it is neither broken nor clashed, a hundred years can be aided;
if it falls to Void or into a pit, it is hard to follow even for one year.

zh: 鬻身者，出乎不得已，须择良善之生，若得世爻旺相生扶，可以聊生，若世落空亡或值日冲月破，虽是暂时安置，毕竟终身落寞，纵然勉强，终是不久者耳。
yi: 卖身的人，是出于不得已，必须选择良善的主人；如果世爻旺相、得到生扶，可以勉强过活；如果世爻落空亡，或者遇到日冲、月破，虽然是暂时安顿，毕竟一生落寞，即使勉强维持，终究不久。
en: Those who sell themselves do so out of necessity and must choose a good and kind master; if the Self line is thriving and supported one can eke out a living; if the Self falls on Void, or meets the Day's clash or Month-break, then although one is temporarily settled, in the end one is desolate all one's life, and even if one makes do it will not last.

note.yi: 「鬻身投主」是把自己卖给主人做奴仆、投靠主人过活。这一章问的是卖身投靠主人，所以世爻是自己，应爻、父母爻是主人（后文「应为主象」「父为主世为我」）。「良善之生」的「生」疑是「主」，译作「良善的主人」。「落陷」是落入空、墓、绝一类凶地（见前）。「聊生」是勉强过活。「日冲」是日辰冲世，「月破」是月建冲破。
note.en: 'Yushen touzhu' is selling oneself to a master as a servant and attaching oneself to a master to live. The chapter asks about selling oneself into a master's service, so the Self is oneself and the Other and Resource are the master (by the later 'the Other is the image of the master' and 'Resource is the master and the Self is me'). The 'sheng' of 'liangshan zhi sheng' is presumably 'zhu', master, and it is translated 'a good and kind master'. 'Falling into a pit' is falling into a bad place such as Void, tomb or extinction (see earlier). 'Liaosheng' is making a bare living. 'Day clash' is the Day clashing the Self, and 'Month-break' is the Month breaking it.

units.chapter: 鬻身投主章第一百三十八
units.chapter_en: Chapter 138: Selling oneself into service under a master
units.title: 鬻身投主：鬼立世中殃有缠身之扰、空临应上主无顾己之情；为祸为灾无非官鬼，若来持世则灾生祸扰，应为主象若值空绝只可苟延岁月是无作养厚情

rule.yi: 官鬼立在世爻上，灾殃缠身、多受烦扰；空亡临在应爻上，主人没有照顾自己的情意。招祸招灾的，无非是官鬼；如果它来持世，就灾生祸扰。应爻是主人的象，如果遇到空、绝，只能苟延岁月，没有养育厚待的情分。
rule.en: If Pressure stands on the Self, calamity entangles one's person with trouble; if Void rests on the Other, the master has no feeling of caring for oneself. What brings misfortune and disaster is nothing but Pressure, and if it comes to hold the Self then disaster arises and misfortune troubles one; the Other is the image of the master, and if it meets Void or extinction one can only drag out one's days, for there is no generous feeling of nurture.

zh: 鬼立世中，殃有缠身之扰。
空临应上，主无顾己之情。
yi: 官鬼立在世爻中，灾殃有缠身的烦扰；
空亡临在应爻上，主人没有照顾自己的情意。
en: If Pressure stands on the Self, calamity entangles one's person with trouble;
if Void rests on the Other, the master has no feeling of caring for oneself.

zh: 为祸为灾，无非官鬼，若来持世，则灾生祸扰。
应为主象，若值空绝，只可苟延岁月，是无作养厚情。
yi: 招祸招灾的，无非是官鬼；如果它来持世，就灾生祸扰。
应爻是主人的象，如果遇到空、绝，只能苟延岁月，是没有养育厚待的情分。
en: What brings misfortune and disaster is nothing but Pressure, and if it comes to hold the Self then disaster arises and misfortune troubles one.
The Other is the image of the master, and if it meets Void or extinction one can only drag out one's days, for there is no generous feeling of nurture.

note.yi: 「缠身之扰」是灾祸缠在身上。「作养」是养育、提携。官鬼在这一章是灾祸之象（「为祸为灾，无非官鬼」），不是官职，与前面求官各章里官鬼是用神、是官职不同。
note.en: 'Chanshen zhi rao' is calamity clinging to one's person. 'Zuoyang' is nurture and support. In this chapter Pressure is the image of calamity ('what brings misfortune and disaster is nothing but Pressure') and not an official post, which differs from the earlier chapters on seeking office where Pressure is the Subject and the official post.

units.chapter: 鬻身投主章第一百三十八
units.chapter_en: Chapter 138: Selling oneself into service under a master
units.title: 鬻身投主：父母生身蒙上辈维持之宠、弟兄克世被同人谤陷之忧；父母乃是主家长上之尊，生身生世者常垂青目之盼，兄弟乃同辈之俦倘来克世则彼肆嫉妨之谋

rule.yi: 父母爻生身，蒙受上辈的维持和宠爱；兄弟克世，有被同辈诽谤陷害的忧虑。父母爻是主人家里的长辈尊者，如果生身、生世，常常被青眼相看；兄弟是同辈的伙伴，如果来克世，他们就放肆地谋划嫉妒、妨碍。
rule.en: If Resource generates the Body, one receives the favour of support from one's elders; if Peer controls the Self, one has the worry of being slandered and trapped by one's fellows. Resource is the honoured elder of the master's household, and if it generates the Body or the Self, one is constantly looked on with a favourable eye; Peer are fellows of one's own rank, and if it comes to control the Self, they give free rein to jealous plots to hinder one.

zh: 父母生身，蒙上辈维持之宠。
弟兄克世，被同人谤陷之忧。
yi: 父母爻生身，蒙受上辈的维持和宠爱；
弟兄克世，有被同辈诽谤陷害的忧虑。
en: If Resource generates the Body, one receives the favour of support from one's elders;
if Peer controls the Self, one has the worry of being slandered and trapped by one's fellows.

zh: 父母乃是主家长上之尊，若生身生世者，常垂青目之盼。
兄弟乃同辈之俦，倘来克世，则彼肆嫉妨之谋。
yi: 父母爻是主人家里的长辈尊者，如果生身、生世，常常被青眼相看。
兄弟是同辈的伙伴，如果来克世，他们就放肆地谋划嫉妒、妨碍。
en: Resource is the honoured elder of the master's household, and if it generates the Body or the Self, one is constantly looked on with a favourable eye.
Peer are fellows of one's own rank, and if it comes to control the Self, they give free rein to jealous plots to hinder one.

note.yi: 「上辈」「长上」是主人家里的长辈。「同人」「同辈之俦」是同为仆役的人。「青目」是青眼，表示好感。「谤陷」是诽谤陷害。
note.en: 'Shangbei' and 'zhangshang' are the elders of the master's household. 'Tongren' and 'tongbei zhi chou' are those who are servants like oneself. 'Qingmu' is the green eye, a look of good will. 'Bangxian' is slandering and entrapping.

units.chapter: 鬻身投主章第一百三十八
units.chapter_en: Chapter 138: Selling oneself into service under a master
units.title: 鬻身投主：世冲父位主仆无缘、财合身官起居有利；父为主世为我不可相戕，若值冲克似为无缘不合难以相利，财为衣禄若得生合世爻则衣禄无亏利资有望

rule.yi: 世爻冲了父爻的位置，主仆没有缘分；财爻与身爻、官爻相合，日常起居有利。父爻是主人、世爻是我，不可互相伤害；如果遇到冲克，就像没有缘分、合不来，难以互相得利；财爻是衣食俸禄，如果生合世爻，衣禄就没有亏缺，利益资财有指望。
rule.en: If the Self clashes with Resource's position, master and servant have no affinity; if Wealth combines with the Body and the star of office, daily life is favourable. Resource is the master and the Self is me, and they must not injure each other; if they meet clash or control, it is as if there were no affinity and no accord, and it is hard to profit one another; Wealth is clothing and pay, and if it generates or combines with the Self line, clothing and pay will not be lacking and profit and funds can be hoped for.

zh: 世冲父位，主仆无缘。
财合身官，起居有利。
yi: 世爻冲了父爻的位置，主仆没有缘分；
财爻与身爻、官爻相合，日常起居有利。
en: If the Self clashes with Resource's position, master and servant have no affinity;
if Wealth combines with the Body and the star of office, daily life is favourable.

zh: 父为主世为我，不可相戕，若值冲克，似为无缘不合难以相利。
财为衣禄，若得生合世爻，则衣禄无亏利资有望。
yi: 父爻是主人、世爻是我，不可互相伤害；如果遇到冲克，就像没有缘分、合不来，难以互相得利。
财爻是衣食俸禄，如果生合世爻，衣禄就没有亏缺，利益资财有指望。
en: Resource is the master and the Self is me, and they must not injure each other; if they meet clash or control, it is as if there were no affinity and no accord, and it is hard to profit one another.
Wealth is clothing and pay, and if it generates or combines with the Self line, clothing and pay will not be lacking and profit and funds can be hoped for.

note.yi: 「相戕」是互相伤害。「起居」是日常生活。「衣禄」是衣食和俸给。这一条的取象：父为主人、世为自己、财为衣禄。
note.en: 'Xiangqiang' is injuring each other. 'Qiju' is daily life. 'Yilu' is clothing and pay. The images taken here: Resource is the master, the Self is oneself, Wealth is clothing and pay.

units.chapter: 鬻身投主章第一百三十八
units.chapter_en: Chapter 138: Selling oneself into service under a master
units.title: 鬻身投主：子旺财明多积蓄、兄兴鬼发染灾非；子动生财财因子助乃积蓄丰余津津不竭，鬼同兄发鬼耗官灾乃灾生财散件件不实

rule.yi: 子孙旺相、财爻分明，积蓄就多；兄爻兴旺、官鬼发动，就染上灾祸是非。子孙发动生财，财得子孙相助，就是积蓄丰余、源源不断；官鬼和兄爻一起发动，官鬼耗损、招官灾，就是灾祸生起、钱财散去，件件都不踏实。
rule.en: If Output is thriving and Wealth is clear, there are many savings; if Peer flourishes and Pressure moves, one is stained with calamity and wrangling. If Output moves to generate Wealth, with Wealth aided by Output, it means abundant savings flowing unceasingly; if Pressure and Peer move together, Pressure wastes substance and brings official disaster, so calamity arises and wealth scatters, and nothing proves solid.

zh: 子旺财明多积蓄，
史兴鬼发染灾非。
yi: 子孙旺相、财爻分明，积蓄就多；
兄爻兴旺、官鬼发动，就染上灾祸是非。
en: If Output is thriving and Wealth is clear, there are many savings;
if Peer flourishes and Pressure moves, one is stained with calamity and wrangling.

zh: 子动生财，财因子助，乃积蓄丰余津津不竭。
鬼同兄发鬼耗官灾，乃灾生财散，件件不实耳。
yi: 子孙发动生财，财因子孙相助，就是积蓄丰余、源源不断。
官鬼和兄爻一起发动，官鬼耗损、招官灾，就是灾祸生起、钱财散去，件件都不踏实。
en: If Output moves to generate Wealth, with Wealth aided by Output, it means abundant savings flowing unceasingly.
If Pressure and Peer move together, Pressure wastes substance and brings official disaster, so calamity arises and wealth scatters, and nothing proves solid.

note.yi: 诀里「史兴鬼发」的「史」疑是「兄」（解里写「鬼同兄发」），译作「兄兴鬼发」。「津津不竭」是源源不断。「官灾」是官司、官府之灾。
note.en: The 'shi' of 'shi xing gui fa' in the verse is presumably 'xiong', Peer (the explanation writes 'Pressure and Peer move together'), and it is translated 'Peer flourishes and Pressure moves'. 'Jinjin bu jie' is flowing without end. 'Guanzai' is official disaster, a lawsuit or a calamity from the authorities.

units.chapter: 鬻身投主章第一百三十八
units.chapter_en: Chapter 138: Selling oneself into service under a master
units.title: 鬻身投主：鬼动并日辰伤世身受天殃、父兴同应位合财室遭主玷；卦中最忌者官鬼也，若发动又同日辰克世者须防不测之灾，若父爻并应爻合财者则主婢淫混

rule.yi: 官鬼发动、并同日辰一起伤克世爻、身爻，会遭天降的灾殃；父爻兴旺、与应位一起合财爻（妻室），会遭主人玷污。卦中最忌的是官鬼：如果它发动、又同日辰一起克世，须防不测的灾祸。财就是妻：如果父爻和应爻一起合财爻，就是主人和婢女淫乱混杂。
rule.en: If Pressure moves and, together with the Day, hurts the Self or the Body, one suffers a calamity sent by heaven; if Resource flourishes and, together with the Other's position, combines with Wealth, the wife line, one suffers dishonour from the master. What is most feared in the hexagram is Pressure: if it moves and, together with the Day, controls the Self, one must guard against an unforeseen disaster. Wealth is the wife: if the Resource line and the Other line together combine with Wealth, it means lewd mixing between the master and the maidservant.

zh: 鬼动并日辰伤世身，受天殃。
父兴同应位合财室，遭主玷。
yi: 官鬼发动、并同日辰一起伤克世爻、身爻，会遭天降的灾殃；
父爻兴旺、与应位一起合财爻（妻室），会遭主人玷污。
en: If Pressure moves and, together with the Day, hurts the Self or the Body, one suffers a calamity sent by heaven;
if Resource flourishes and, together with the Other's position, combines with Wealth, the wife line, one suffers dishonour from the master.

zh: 卦中最忌者，官鬼也。
若发动又同日辰克世者，须防不测之灾。
财者，妻也。
若父爻并应爻合财者，则主婢淫混。
yi: 卦中最忌的，是官鬼。
如果它发动、又同日辰一起克世，须防不测的灾祸。
财就是妻。
如果父爻和应爻一起合财爻，就是主人和婢女淫乱混杂。
en: What is most feared in the hexagram is Pressure.
If it moves and, together with the Day, controls the Self, one must guard against an unforeseen disaster.
Wealth is the wife.
If the Resource line and the Other line together combine with Wealth, it means lewd mixing between the master and the maidservant.

note.yi: 「遭主玷」「主婢淫混」讲的是主人与家里妇女（财爻代表的妻室、婢女）之间的不端行为；书里只此一句，没有展开。官鬼在这一章是灾祸之象。「同日辰」是跟日辰一道。
note.en: 'Zao zhu dian' and 'zhu bi yin hun' speak of improper conduct between the master and the women of the household (the wife and maidservants whom the Wealth line stands for); the book says only this and does not go into it. Pressure in this chapter is the image of calamity. 'Tong richen' is together with the Day.

units.chapter: 鬻身投主章第一百三十八
units.chapter_en: Chapter 138: Selling oneself into service under a master
units.title: 鬻身投主：多是多非盖为动爻临朱雀、常来常往皆因主象值游魂；朱雀主口舌若值动爻则终朝咭聒寝食不宁，游魂为游荡若卜此卦乃流荡忘返萍踪浪迹之徒；再推之卦之合冲方决始终之遐迩，之卦者变卦也细辨其中之冲合可断终身之吉凶

rule.yi: 多是多非，是因为动爻临朱雀；常来常往，是因为主人的象值游魂。朱雀主口舌，如果值动爻，就整天被吵闹、睡吃不安；游魂是游荡，如果卜得这个卦，就是流荡忘返、萍踪浪迹的人。再推之卦（变卦）的合冲，才能决断这件事从头到尾是远是近；「之卦」就是变卦，细细辨别其中的冲合，可以断一生的吉凶。
rule.en: Many quarrels and much wrangling are because a moving line sits on the Vermilion Bird; constant coming and going is because the master image falls on a Wandering Soul. The Vermilion Bird governs wrangling, and if it falls on a moving line one is clamoured at all day long and neither sleep nor food is in peace; the Wandering Soul is wandering, and if this hexagram is cast one is a drifter who wanders and forgets to return, like duckweed's trace and a wave's track. Then reckon the combination or clash in the changed hexagram, and only then decide how far or near it is from beginning to end; the 'zhi gua' is the changed hexagram, and by carefully distinguishing the clash and combination in it one can judge the good or ill of one's whole life.

zh: 多是多非，盖为动爻临朱雀。
常来常往，皆因主象值游魂。
yi: 多是多非，是因为动爻临朱雀；
常来常往，都因为主人的象值游魂。
en: Many quarrels and much wrangling are because a moving line sits on the Vermilion Bird;
constant coming and going is because the master image falls on a Wandering Soul.

zh: 朱雀主口舌，若值动爻，则终朝咭聒寝食不宁。
游魂为游荡，若卜此卦，乃流荡忘返萍踪浪迹之徒耳。
yi: 朱雀主口舌，如果值动爻，就整天被吵闹，睡吃不安。
游魂是游荡，如果卜得这个卦，就是流荡忘返、萍踪浪迹的人。
en: The Vermilion Bird governs wrangling, and if it falls on a moving line one is clamoured at all day long and neither sleep nor food is in peace.
The Wandering Soul is wandering, and if this hexagram is cast one is a drifter who wanders and forgets to return, like duckweed's trace and a wave's track.

zh: 再推之卦之合冲，方决始终之遐迩。
yi: 再推之卦的合冲，才能决断这件事从头到尾是远是近。
en: Then reckon the combination or clash in the changed hexagram, and only then decide how far or near it is from beginning to end.

zh: 之卦者，变卦也。
细辨其中之冲合，可断终身之吉凶耳。
yi: 「之卦」就是变卦。
细细辨别其中的冲合，就可以断一生的吉凶。
en: The 'zhi gua' is the changed hexagram.
By carefully distinguishing the clash and combination in it one can judge the good or ill of one's whole life.

note.yi: 「咭聒」是吵闹。「萍踪浪迹」是像浮萍、浪花一样没有定处。「之卦」是变卦（发动的爻变出来的卦）。「游魂」是八宫卦里每宫的第七卦（见术语表）。「主象值游魂」是应、父等代表主人的象落在游魂卦上，书里没有细说。「始终之遐迩」是从头到尾是远是近（时间的久暂）。这是鬻身投主一章的收尾。
note.en: 'Jigua' is clamour. 'Pingzong langji' is having no fixed place, like duckweed and the foam of the waves. 'Zhigua' is the changed hexagram (the hexagram that the moving lines turn into). 'Wandering Soul' is the seventh hexagram of each of the eight palaces (see the glossary). 'The master image falls on a Wandering Soul' is the images that stand for the master, such as the Other and Resource, falling on a Wandering Soul hexagram, and the book does not go into it. 'Shizhong zhi xia'er' is how far or near from beginning to end, meaning how long or short in time. This closes the chapter on selling oneself into service.
